title: Ohio Cannabis Ecosystem Directory
description: An Ohio cannabis ecosystem directory with 564 preserved original organization identities: 515 public listings across 16 categories, 48 retained records and one withdrawn listing excluded from public views and CSV exports. Includes 60 source-linked business relationships, business-help shortcuts, scoped provider reviews, Ohio resources, events and educational tools. Review dates describe evidence checks, not a guarantee of current eligibility, licenses or inventory.
